title: Polite verbs: ～ます and ～ません
meaning_en: Polite present/future statement; ません is its negative.
explanation: Polite verbs end in ます: たべます (eat/will eat), のみます (drink). The negative ends in ません: たべません (do not eat).
The same form covers the present and the near future: あした いきます = "I will go tomorrow". Make a question by adding か: たべます か.
Answer a question with はい + ます form or いいえ + ません form.
structure_notes: Verb stem + ます / ません (+ か).
common_mistakes: Using です after a verb.
Answering いいえ with a positive verb.

title: を: the object of an action
meaning_en: Marks what the action is done to.
explanation: を marks the thing the verb acts on: ほん を よみます (read a book). It is pronounced "o" and written only as a particle.
ください follows the same rule: そば を ください (soba, please).
N を します means "to do N": べんきょう を します.
common_mistakes: Using は where を is needed.

title: で: where and how
pattern: place で verb / means で verb
meaning_en: At (a place where an action happens); by, in (means or language).
explanation: で marks the place where an action happens: スーパー で パン を かいます (buy bread at the supermarket).
で also marks the means: バス で いきます (go by bus), にほんご で はなします (speak in Japanese).
Compare に: に marks where something exists or a time, で marks where an action is done.
common_mistakes: Using に instead of で for where an action happens.
Using で with あるいて.

title: へ: toward a place
pattern: place へ いきます / きます / かえります
explanation: へ marks the direction of movement: がっこう へ いきます. Pronounce the particle へ as "e".
It is used with いきます, きます and かえります. に can replace へ in these cases.
Ask where with どこ へ いきます か.
